content.text:
{"address":"004ae750","function_name":"Selection__DispatchMultiUnitOrder","comment":"Selection__DispatchMultiUnitOrder — iterate g_CurrentObjects, send an order
to each selected unit.

Arguments:
  param_1 = target ObjectClass* (0 if ground-targeted)
  param_2 = cell/coord target
  param_3 = order type (1 = Move/AttackMove, 2 = Guard-variant, other = Stop)

Pre-hook loop: calls vtable[0x1a4] on every selected unit (clears formation
state at +0x430 when bit 2 of +0x14 is set — cancels group-move coordination).

Dispatch:
  - Ground-targeted (param_1 == 0):
      vtable[0x70] = compute cell order (What_Action for cell)
      vtable[0x140] = execute cell order
  - Object-targeted (param_1 != 0):
      vtable[0x74] = compute object order (What_Action for ObjectClass)
      vtable[0x144] = execute object order

NO group-pathing, NO leader, NO formation movement — each unit resolves
its own path from its own position. Voice suppression (g_SelectionVoice_Enable)
toggles off inside the loop and is restored to 1 on exit.

Early-out if g_IsMapEditor != 0.

2026-09-30 bridge Engineer input integration: native function entry is 004AE750; 004AE844 is the object-click virtual+144 call, not an entry. Original object loop004AE829 loads g_CurrentObjects_Data[ESI], calls that object's virtual+74 WhatAction at004AE83A and its virtual+144 ClickedAction at004AE844, then increments ESI and compares to the live count at004AE858 before looping004AE824. This establishes per-selected-object dispatch order for mixed Engineer/C4/Attack batches. Captured original static instruction bytes: tools/spatial_oracle/engineer_bridge_selection_dispatch.json (SHA-pinned gamemd.exe). This is control-flow evidence, not native execution of the entire handler. Rust restores order for single-object command batches only; existing aggregated SetRally representation, mouse discovery/modifiers, pre-hook/formation cleanup and whole window delivery remain outside that adapter proof. Original action29/32 and Foot enqueue admission are executed separately in engineer_bridge_cursor_caller.json."}
